jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Senior backend engineer to build and operate payment services. Python on PostgreSQL, deployed on Kubernetes, owning reliability.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Backend engineer to build APIs in Python against PostgreSQL. You will work on internal services and reporting tools.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data engineer to build and own ETL pipelines with Airflow and Spark, loading a warehouse used across the business.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Machine learning engineer to train and serve ranking models in PyTorch, working on retrieval and embeddings.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Frontend engineer to build accessible interfaces in React and TypeScript, owning a component library.

jobs.title: Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Platform engineer to run Kubernetes, manage infrastructure as code in Terraform, and own CI/CD.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: SRE to own observability with Prometheus and Grafana, run incident response, and manage error budgets on Kubernetes.

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: Application security engineer to run threat modelling, own SAST and DAST pipelines, and review services against OWASP ASVS.
